verdicts.reason: A: the CTA is shrunk to an unreadable pill at the bottom right, below an oversized SAVE 15% badge, so the action is buried. The body copy is jammed under the headline, the photo panel is an empty brown block that has lost the product, and the bag and logo are reduced to tiny bottom-corner icons. B has the same empty photo block, the same oversized badge, the same tiny bag and logo, and body copy that crowds into the image. B also wrongly puts the CTA above the headline, but its CTA is at least legible and the headline is set more strongly, so it is the less broken of the two.
